response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acct_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acct_avg) AS region_figure FROM acct GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_avg, r.region_figure / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_avg FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_figure > o.overall_avg ORDER BY r.region_figure DESC

assumptions.assumption: All trans.amount values are averaged as stored (unsigned), regardless of trans.type, since the request says to average transaction amounts.
The all-region average is the unweighted mean of the regional figures (each region counts once), as the request says 'average across all regions'.
Accounts with no transactions have no per-account average and are excluded.
